message: Desk 0.1.39 fixes the Create R/O label printing the license plate instead of the car model. The model now comes only from the vehicle Model / Year-Make-Model field: plate and plate-state fields are skipped, plate fragments like ABC 123 are rejected, and a plate shown on the page can never win. Last name and the label layout are unchanged.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
